use default
use System.Text.StringBuilder

let alphabet_size = 256

compress(text: string) -> List[int] is
    let codes = MAP()

    for code in 0..alphabet_size do
        codes["{cast char(code)}"] = code
    od

    let compressed = LIST()
    let current mut = ""

    for character in text do
        let extended = "{current}{character}"

        if codes.contains_key(extended) then
            current = extended
        else
            compressed.add(codes[current])
            codes[extended] = codes.count
            current = "{character}"
        fi
    od

    if current.length > 0 then
        compressed.add(codes[current])
    fi

    return compressed
si

decompress(compressed: List[int]) -> string is
    if compressed.count == 0 then
        return ""
    fi

    let words = LIST()

    for code in 0..alphabet_size do
        words.add("{cast char(code)}")
    od

    let text = StringBuilder()
    let previous mut = words[compressed[0]]

    text.append(previous)

    for code in compressed |> skip(1) do
        let word =
            if code < words.count then
                words[code]
            else
                "{previous}{previous[0]}"
            fi

        text.append(word)
        words.add("{previous}{word[0]}")

        previous = word
    od

    return text.to_string()
si

let original = "TOBEORNOTTOBEORTOBEORNOT"
let compressed = compress(original)

write_line(original)
write_line(compressed |> join(" "))
write_line(decompress(compressed))
